security_scope: Disposable public fixtures run with genuine Chou-Orlandi and IKNP input OT. This experiment has no wallet secrets, persistent signing shares, production peer authentication, or threshold signatures.
measurement_scope: Client wall time includes request and response transport. Worker Date.now observations are elapsed markers. CPU billing and actual physical placement require separate platform evidence.
sampling_scope: One warm-up precedes each kernel. The measured samples establish observed latency only; they do not establish a production tail-latency bound.

reproduction.authentication: PROBE_TOKEN is read from the environment for hosted runs. Its value is never included in this artifact.

report.placement: Incoming colo identifies the request entry point. It does not prove equal physical placement of both Workers.

a.linear_memory_scope: Current isolate-wide Wasm linear memory. Memory can grow across earlier operations. JavaScript buffers and total Worker memory are excluded.

runtime.memory_scope: Only the label arena is an allocation measurement. Message byte fields are maximum lengths. OT state, Wasm linear memory, and host queues are excluded.

transport.clock: Worker Date.now; IO can advance this clock. These values are elapsed observations, not CPU billing measurements.
